spans.s: ॐ—कार (ॐ-क्˚), m. the sacred and mystical syllable ओम्, the exclamation ओम्, pronouncing the syllable ओम्, Mn. ii, 75; 81; Kathās.; Bhag. &c., (cf. विजयोंकार, कृतोंकार)
a beginning, prosperous or auspicious beginning of (e.g. a science), Bālar.
ॐ—कारा f. a Buddhist Śakti or female personification of divine energy, L.
ॐ—कार—ग्रन्थ m. N. of wk. of Nārāyaṇa
ॐ—कार—तीर्थ n. N. of a Tīrtha
ॐ—कार—पीठ n. N. of a place
ॐ—कार—भट्ट m. N. of a man.
ॐ—˚कारीय Nom. P. ओंकारीयति, to be an Oṃkāra (?) Comm. on Pāṇ. vi, 1, 95.
ॐ—कृत mfn. having an uttered ओम्
